steps.en: Install the local plugin and sign WDA for your USB-connected iPhone
steps.zh: 安装本地插件，为 USB 真机签名配置 WDA

steps.en: Reuse or start WDA and prove the phone session is ready
steps.zh: 复用或启动 WDA，并证明手机会话就绪

steps.en: Authorize a concrete phone task and its expected final result
steps.zh: 授权具体手机任务，说明最终期望结果

steps.en: Return screen observations and execute the model's chosen phone actions
steps.zh: 返回读屏信息并执行模型选择的手机动作

steps.en: Provide fresh observations for final-result verification
steps.zh: 提供新观察，供核验最终结果

value.en: Complete supervised tasks inside apps on your actual iPhone
value.zh: 在本人监督下处理真实 iPhone App 内的任务
